# Horizon, State, Authority {#sec-trajectory-contract}

::: {.callout-note title="Outline scaffold"}

This page makes the agreed chapter architecture renderable in Quarto. It records the chapter question, planned coverage, and intended systems outcome; full manuscript prose, figures, worked examples, fallacies, and exercises remain to be developed.

:::

## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_What contract must a runtime preserve across the full life of an agent trajectory?_

## Planned Coverage

- The managed trajectory and its admission, continuation, and termination conditions
- Horizon as decision depth, elapsed time, resource exposure, and accumulated uncertainty
- State ownership, versioning, checkpoints, and provenance
- Authority as capability scope, duration, budget, and blast radius
- A trajectory control record as an implementation artifact rather than the book's organizing ontology

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to specify the control envelope for a trajectory and identify which invariant would be violated by an unsafe continuation.
